name: secondary-playfield
display_name: Secondary playfield (white welding table with black cross)
frame: origin at the field centre; x east (camera image right), y north (camera image top); the aprilcam world frame for this playfield

image.axes: x right = east, y down = south; template px (x,y) <-> cm: x_cm=(x-440)/8, y_cm=(280-y)/8

source.method: raw frame undistorted with the plumb-line lens model (see `lens`), then a homography from the FOUR CORNER ArUco markers at (+-55, +-35) assumed exact, warped to 8 px/cm. Edge-middle markers are deliberately not used: they carry 1-3 cm placement error.

aprilcam_calibration.caveat: fx and k1 lie on an unresolved ridge (9 coplanar points); valid only as a pair. The plumb-line check below says the lens is nearly rectilinear, so this k1 mostly absorbed marker placement error.

lens.method: plumb-line: k1 that maximises straightness of the field's drawn lines in the raw frame at fixed f (2026-09-04); uncorrected straightness 0.635 px rms, corrected 0.612 px -- effectively rectilinear

cross_reference_cm._note: tag-free deskew anchors, measured on playfield.png by `fieldtools.py features` (playfield cm)
